title: Exact Unicode identity pair on PostgreSQL18.7
question: Do the exact selected Python/UCD and PostgreSQL builtin collation agree on Unicode default folding over the supported PostgreSQL text domain?
method: Read-only comparison of every supported scalar mapping, plus six independently specified sequence cases and a changed-determinant refusal at the Python admission boundary. No normalization is applied.

inputs.role: original campaign and probe implementation snapshot

outputs.role: exact runtime pair, full mapping digest, independent cases and refusals

conclusion: The exact CPython3.14.10/UCD16.0.0 and PostgreSQL18.7/UTF8/builtin pg_unicode_fast version1 pair agrees on every supported scalar mapping, excluding NUL and surrogates. Six independent sequences agree; composed and decomposed strings remain distinct. Exact observed determinants pass admission; previous18.6 and corrupted collation determinants refuse. This read-only qualification authorizes no schema change, deployment, activation or DDO resumption; integrated repairs retain their own targeted receipts.
